helpDescription.overview: Welcome to Accessible Smart Map! We provide place search, route planning, and accessibility information across all of Taiwan. Accessibility data (restrooms, ramps, elevators, etc.) currently covers some counties/cities, with more being added continuously.

general.title:
1. Basic search and navigation
Across Taiwan you can use the following basic features:
features: Search places: enter a business name, attraction, or address in the search box above, or just ask the AI assistant, e.g. "any accessible restrooms nearby?"
Route planning: after finding a place, click navigation to plan a route, choosing a normal/wheelchair/elderly/visually-impaired mode as needed.

AI assistant: tap the 💬 icon or the mic in the bottom-right to wake it — just ask in plain language, e.g. "is this area easy to get around?" or "plan a wheelchair route to Taipei Main Station". It looks up live data to answer, and remembers the accessibility needs you set in Settings so you don't have to repeat them.

More features: the side rail directly opens accessibility, bus arrivals, accessible parking, saved places, and environment info panels; the "More" button opens hazard reporting and the welfare directory; live air quality and weather show up top; and the "SOS" button sends a one-tap alert to your emergency contacts.

taipei.title: 2. Accessibility facility search (data coverage is expanding)

features.filter: Tap the "Accessibility" icon on the side rail to filter map pins by facility type — accessible restroom, accessible ramp, or elevator. Accessibility data currently covers some counties/cities, with more being added continuously.

icons: Accessible restroom: indicates the location has a spacious restroom equipped with grab bars.
Accessible ramp: indicates the main entrance of the location is level or has a ramp.
Elevator / Lift: indicates the location has an elevator or vertical lift equipment.

feedback.title:
3. How to report issues or provide suggestions
Your feedback helps us improve:
steps: Click the account icon in the bottom-left corner and select "Feedback".
Fill in the details of your issue or suggestion and submit.
examples: Accessibility info: "The accessible ramp at A Cafe has been removed."
Navigation: "Route planning was incorrect when navigating in Taichung."
Suggest a new place: "Recommend B Restaurant — they have an accessible restroom."

items.question: Q: Why can't I find any accessibility icons or filter options in my area?
items.answer: A: Accessibility data is a database we're continuously expanding — it currently covers some counties/cities, with more being added over time. You can still use general place search and navigation anywhere in the meantime. Thank you for your support and patience!

items.question: Q: Why don't I see updates immediately after submitting accessibility feedback?
items.answer: A: Thank you for your report! To ensure accuracy, all submissions undergo manual review by our team, which takes some time. Please wait patiently for the update to appear.

items.question: Q: I'd like to see the help guide or first-run tour again — where can I find them?
items.answer: A: This help guide can be reopened any time from the account menu. The first-run tour (the four-step intro shown on first launch) can be restarted from Settings → General → "Replay onboarding tour".
